sources.label: FluffyDiscord Screen Recorder
sources.author: FluffyDiscord Screen Recorder
patch_list: Cuts an "H" into the camera of the Screen Recorder tile icon.
Adds 120, 144, 165 and 185 fps, encodes every new screen frame with its own timestamp, and installs the recorder as a separate app next to the stock one.
